vision: Bringing Urban Innovation to Rural America™
mission: To develop a better quality of life for people within underserved communities through initiatives that improve economic and social sustainability. COREI™ will do this through charity, education and training, sports and recreation, medical and health services, fitness, and advocacy.

missionFocus.title: Focusing on Empowerment and Action
missionFocus.description: To unite residents and provide resources, building a stronger community where empowered individuals create lasting change and shared prosperity together.

missionFocus.title: Focusing on Connection and Belonging
missionFocus.description: To cultivate connection and mutual support, weaving together the fabric of the community so that every voice is heard, and every person feels at home.

missionFocus.title: Focusing on Vision and Future
missionFocus.description: We are focused on a future built by us, for us—uplifting local voices and driving the initiatives that will define our community's success.

goals: Create a state-of-the-art sports, education, fitness, and conference complex.
Offer vocational and certification programs and virtual educational classes.
Build affordable housing for veterans and seniors.
Provide a medical, wellness, and veteran services center.
Offer childcare, Pre-K, and Kid Zone services.
Develop an outdoor kids' playground, park, and event area (weddings, family reunions, concerts, etc.).
Build living quarters (hotel, Airbnb, motel, or garden-type units).
Host church meetings, retreats, and conventions.
coreValuesDescription: COREI™ implements a proactive approach that reinforces these core values and embraces change and flexibility. To foster resilience and promote growth, COREI™ seeks to cultivate strong relationships with the community, encouraging residents to embrace change, learn from it, and respond effectively.

leadership.empowerment: COREI™ is committed to providing community members with the necessary tools, resources, and environment to thrive, leading to increased motivation, productivity, and a strong sense of value and purpose.
leadership.innovation: COREI™ was founded on the principle of bringing urban innovation to rural America. COREI™ believes that innovation is not a one-time engagement, but an ongoing process to refine products, operations, and services. This commitment is our passion.
